pattern: に忍びない（にしのびない）
purpose: Find an action emotionally too painful to perform or witness.
keywords: I cannot bear to throw away these clothes full of memories.
I cannot bear to look at the injured bird.
I cannot bear to refuse his desperate request.
restrictions: Common with 見る, 聞く, 捨てる, and 断る.
mistake: This is emotional reluctance, not a physical inability.

segments.role: Find an action emotionally too painful to perform or witness. V dictionary + に忍びない
